evidence.title: WA UI — WhatsApp Web UI components for shadcn/ui
GitHub - froggy1014/wa-ui: shadcn/ui registry of WhatsApp Web chat components, built on WhatsApp's WDS design tokens

name: WA UI
summary: shadcn/ui registry of WhatsApp Web chat components built on WhatsApp's WDS design tokens.
description: Chat components — bubbles, headers, message input, typing indicator, media and sticker bubbles, and Meta Business template and interactive messages — styled with the same CSS variables WhatsApp Web ships (WDS). Each of the 29 registry items installs independently with npx shadcn add; light and dark mode included.
contains: 29 shadcn registry items across chat, media, templates and extras
chat bubble, chat header, chat list item, chat menu, message input, message status, date separator, typing indicator
image, video, voice, file and sticker bubbles; business template and carousel messages
built on WhatsApp Web WDS tokens; light and dark mode
installs with npx shadcn add; Tailwind CSS v4 and Base UI
